# `inline`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
inline(expr)
```

Explodes an array of structs into a table. Uses column names col1, col2, etc. by default unless specified otherwise.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `generator_funcs` |
| Kind | generator (table function) |
| Added in Spark | 3.4.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
SELECT * FROM inline(array(struct(1, 'a'), struct(2, 'b')));
```

Result:

```text
1	a
2	b
```

```sql
SELECT * FROM inline(input => array(struct(1, 'a'), struct(2, 'b')));
```

Result:

```text
1	a
2	b
```
